deterministicFindings.title: Lisinopril with ibuprofen
deterministicFindings.finding: Concurrent NSAID use can worsen renal function in susceptible patients; renal function should be monitored.

deterministicFindings.title: Lisinopril with elevated potassium
deterministicFindings.finding: Elevated potassium is a medication-safety concern in a patient receiving lisinopril.

unstructuredContext: Recent discharge summary lists lisinopril as a chronic medication and ibuprofen as an as-needed medication. Potassium was elevated on follow-up testing.
